Subject: Request: Dedicated GPU architecture review — pool sizing & failover

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the Hosted trial — the team is ready to scope a short Dedicated POC and we want to make sure the architecture fits our mixed workload (low-latency chat, batch embeddings, nightly retraining). Could we schedule a technical deep-dive this week to cover: pool sizing guidance, autoscaling behavior under burst, tenant isolation and failover strategy, and any recommended quantization/latency trade-offs?

Preferable windows: Thu 8/27 10:00–13:00 ET or Fri 8/28 09:00–12:00 ET. Our security/infra lead (Evan Patel) will join.

I've attached a short requirements spreadsheet (finchem-poc-requirements.xlsx) with expected QPS, peak concurrency, and data residency notes. Also would like a quick note on what telemetry/logs Redwood provides during a POC (token-level cost, per-model latencies, audit logs).

Can you confirm availability and expected attendees from your side?

Best,
Fiona
Fiona Gomez
Director, ML Eng
FinChem Analytics

- Pool topology & sizing (Aditya) (20 min)
- Autoscaling policies + burst/fallback options (Karthik) (20 min)
- Isolation and multi-tenant failover strategies (Irene) (15 min)
- Telemetry, logs, and SOC2/audit evidence (Marissa) (10 min)
- Q&A + next steps (10–15 min)

We can do Thu 8/27 11:00–12:00 ET or Fri 8/28 10:00–11:00 ET — both work for the engineers on our side. Which would you prefer? I've cc'd Aditya (serving/runtime) and Karthik (capacity/autoscale) so they can prep. We'll attach a short agenda and a runbook stub prior to the call.
